sentences.en: Starvation and disease were rampant among the lowest classes.
sentences.zh: 最低阶层中饥荒和疾病猖獗。

sentences.en: Fiscal austerity is considered to be an answer to the rampant inflation.
sentences.zh: 财政紧缩被认为是遏制通货膨胀泛滥的答案。

sentences.en: There are many latent gays among rampant homophobes.
sentences.zh: 在那些极端恐同的人中间，存在着许多潜在的同性恋者。
